title: PMDA regulatory update on approval and revision of the precautions for use of anticancer drugs in Japan; tovorafenib and dordaviprone for glioma, mirvetuximab soravtansine and pembrolizumab for ovarian cancer, tislelizumab for nasopharyngeal cancer, trastuzumab deruxtecan, palbociclib and datopotamab deruxtecan for breast cancer, epcoritamab for lymphoma, teclistamab for multiple myeloma.
